clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for perforated non-reinforced concrete pipes for use in underdrainage work Note— Reinforced cement concrete perforated concrete pipes may be  supplied by mutual agreement between the purchaser and the supplier. Note— These pipes are used for  underdrainage work in infiltration  galleries, reclaiming water logged areas and for similar other purposes

clauses.title: Classification
clauses.text: 2. Classification a) Circular perforation pipes— 5 to 8 mm diameter perforations arranged in rows parallel to the axis of the pipe. Perforations shall be approximately 75 mm centre to centre, along rows. The rows shall be spaced over not more than 165°of  the circumference. b) Slotted perforation pipes— Slots shall be circumferential in direction, not more than 5 mm nor less than 3mmin width, and of the lengths shown in Table 1. There shall be two rows of slots, spaced 165° SUMMARY OF IS 7319 : 1974   PERFORATED CONCRETE PIPES

clauses.title: Shall be free from
clauses.text: 4.1 Shall be free from  fractures, cracks and blisters laminations and surface roughness.

clauses.title: Specials
clauses.text: 4.3. Specials — shall have spigot and socket ends. Curves shall be at   900, 450 and   221/20

clauses.title: Three edge bearing test
clauses.text: 5.1 Three edge bearing test or sand bearing test.

clauses.title: Absorption Test
clauses.text: 5.2 Absorption Test — Total absorption at the end of 24 h shall  not exceed 8 percent of dry weight.
